issues.legal_issue: Interim relief should prevent execution of a decree while a suit challenging that decree for fraud and collusion is pending, where the decree set aside a final award through a compromise made by an official without government authority.
material_facts: A final award under the Forest Act had been made for acquired land, and replacement land had been provided as compensation.
The State was in possession of the property when the respondents sued it for a declaration of title and damages.
After the State contested that suit, a forest official, without authority from the State Government, compromised the matter, resulting in a decree setting aside the award.
The State later brought a suit alleging fraud and collusion and seeking to set aside the decree, and applied for an injunction pending that suit.
The respondents sought to execute the challenged decree, and the lower courts refused interim relief.
issues.conclusion: The refusal of an injunction was a manifest error of law. The appeal was allowed and an interim injunction restraining execution of the challenged decree was ordered pending the suit.
issues.legal_principle: Applying Order XXXIX, Rules 1 and 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure, the Court held that interim protection against execution was warranted in these circumstances: a final award had been set aside by a compromise made without State Government authority, the State was asserting fraud and collusion, and it had been in possession of the property. Section 16 of the Indian Forest Act was the basis of the original award; Section 47 of the Code of Civil Procedure had been invoked earlier in an objection to execution. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: appeal_from_denial_of_interim_injunction and government_suit_challenges_decree_for_fraud and decree_set_aside_final_award and official_lacked_government_authority_to_compromise and government_possessed_property and execution_of_decree_is_sought

predicates.appeal_from_denial_of_interim_injunction: A government party appealed after a court denied its application for an interim injunction.
predicates.government_suit_challenges_decree_for_fr: The government brought a pending suit alleging fraud in obtaining a decree and seeking to set it aside.
predicates.decree_set_aside_final_award: The challenged decree set aside an award that had become final.
predicates.official_lacked_government_authority_to_: An official compromised the case without authority from the government.
predicates.government_possessed_property: The government was in possession of the property when the opposing party brought its suit.
predicates.execution_of_decree_is_sought: The opposing party sought to execute the challenged decree.
predicates.execution_of_challenged_decree_is_enjoin: Execution of the challenged decree is restrained while the suit challenging it remains pending.

issues.definition: When the government appeals the denial of interim relief in a pending fraud challenge to a decree that set aside a final award through an unauthorized official compromise, and the government possessed the property and execution is sought, execution of that decree is restrained pending the suit.
